intentionalChanges.field: Updated for B24 floor-based signed integer sampling; seeded changes approved by user. Then: Brush dots and stamps are now generated on the GPU from hashed randomness: same distribution and ink (within ~2% of 2.3.0), different seeded realization. Approved by user 2026-10-27. Then: density-invariant dot footprint (F01); these scenes render at density 1, where fine brushes are now ~4x lighter, matching density 2. Then: strokes are drawn on the default paper tooth (strength 0.5), seeded by brush.seed(). Then: the paper tooth is removed (approved 2026-10-28); strokes render as before it was added. Then: brush.seed() no longer draws the fill Gaussian pools from the main random stream (they follow the seed through their own streams), so seeded strokes take a different realization. Approved by user 2026-11-20.

intentionalChanges.wash: Fill and wash layers are rasterised on the GPU into a half-float log-space mask instead of Canvas2D (docs/rendering.md): no 8-bit quantisation, GPU antialiasing. Same polygons; sub-pixel edge and quantisation differences only.
